zh.title: 民航局舉辦無人機及先進空中交通論壇 聚焦國際航空安全規範
zh.summary: 民航局11月23日舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇，邀國外民航主管機關與專家交流。
body: 交通部民用航空局11月23日舉辦「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」，聚焦國際無人機與先進空中交通（AAM）發展，以及國際航空安全規範。論壇邀請國外民航主管機關與專家分享實務經驗。
民航局表示，希望論壇深化國內產業交流，促進無人機及先進空中交通的法規、標準與技術進展，也盼藉國外專家分享，讓臺灣無人機產業與制度接軌國際。
民航局指出，先進空中交通要從技術研發走向實際營運，仍須建立適航認證、安全監理及空域整合機制，這也是各國民航主管機關共同面對的課題。

en.title: Taiwan CAA holds forum on drones, advanced air mobility and safety standards
en.summary: Taiwan's CAA held a drone and advanced air mobility forum on Nov. 23, inviting foreign regulators and experts.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) held an international forum on drones and advanced air mobility (AAM) on Nov. 23. The 2026 forum focused on international drone and AAM development and international aviation safety standards. Foreign civil aviation authorities and experts were invited to share practical experience.

The CAA said it hopes the forum will deepen exchanges within Taiwan's industry and promote progress in regulations, standards and technology for drones and AAM. It also aims to bring Taiwan's drone industry and systems closer to international practice.

The agency said moving AAM from research and development to actual operations requires mechanisms for airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration. It described this as a challenge facing civil aviation authorities worldwide.
